title: kate-core: use the fileio encoding lookup
summary: config.rs calls kate_fileio::encoding_for_label. kate-core already depends on kate-fileio, so the call points down. utf-8 still loads. The replacement label is still an error. This packet does not edit kate-fileio. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust. It does not need a window or a review by the owner. Linux CI runs the tests. Also run cargo check for aarch64-apple-darwin.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Replace the doc comment above encoding_for_label. The old comment says the label table is for_label_no_replacement on that type. The new comment says kate-fileio owns the label table. It also says this function calls kate_fileio::encoding_for_label. The function body is that call. Delete the Deref target from this file. Do not change kate-fileio. Do not derive PartialEq. config::tests::replacement_label_is_rejected must still pass. That test accepts utf-8 and rejects replacement. Gate 1 does not require a new regression test for this delegation. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.
